public_rationale: The studies substantiate important reliability and generalization failures. They also show useful abilities across interactive tasks. Neither finding settles whether contemporary systems collectively fell below the stated human-comparable standard. The unrestricted reference to machines and the missing human baseline make a categorical verdict stronger than the evidence supports.
limitations: Failures on several tasks cannot establish the absence of the claimed capability in every AI system.
Success in several environments does not establish general human-comparable reliability.
The assessment treats the passage as a claim renewed in 2023.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current AI systems lack intelligence that is flexible and general with resourcefulness and reliability comparable to humans, especially reliability.

statement.excerpt: Current machines can’t do this, especially not the reliability part.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: resourcefulness and reliability comparable to (or beyond) human intelligence
our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns systems combining broad competence with human-comparable reliability, rather than whether machines can perform any individual task reliably.
Interpret 'current' as current when the post reapplies the definition in October 2023. The passage's reference to last year's discussion creates a genuine timing ambiguity.
Use 2023 through publication as the current research period because the claim supplies no narrower reporting interval.
Allow ordinary human fallibility. The mere existence of model errors does not settle the human comparison.
Evidence confined to LLMs cannot by itself establish an unrestricted claim about every kind of AI system.
criteria.support_condition: Broad evaluations of contemporary general-purpose systems establish substantial deficits against humans in the combined flexibility, resourcefulness and reliability standard.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one contemporary system demonstrates the combined standard across representative general tasks under comparable human and machine conditions.

evidence.explanation: Tests of multiplication, logic puzzles and dynamic programming identified weaknesses in systematic multi-step problem solving. They support a narrower reliability criticism, but do not measure every system or establish an overall human comparison.

AgentBench found meaningful interactive capabilities, including 78% success for GPT-4 in its household environment, alongside instruction-following failures. These results qualify a blanket incapability claim but do not establish human-comparable general intelligence.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable human and system evaluations across representative cognitive tasks, with an explicit system scope and reliability standard, would resolve the central comparison.
